custody.rawCaptureRetention: Working capture; not part of the public commit. The public immutable receipt preserves factual observations and digests, not a replayable HTTP archive.

crossSourceReview.scope: Related provider review synthesized across the manifest sourceIds; a method page need not itself contain the numerical forecast.

facts.houseEventReview: The Horizon edition gives a 98 percent House majority probability, and the House page defines the majority as 218 of 435.
facts.senateEventReview: The Senate page establishes 51 and a Republican 50-seat tiebreak. Its treatment of de facto party nominees does not establish a complete, identical independent-caucus mapping.
